segments.name: Sally Beauty
segments.description: Omni-channel retailer of professional-quality beauty supplies to retail consumers and salon professionals through stores and digital channels.
segments.evidence: Sally operates primarily through retail stores (generally operating under the Sally Beauty banner) and digital platforms, including our www.sallybeauty.com website, a mobile commerce-based app, and third-party digital marketplaces.

segments.name: Beauty Systems Group
segments.description: Distributor of professional beauty supplies exclusively to salons and licensed beauty professionals through company-operated and franchised stores and digital platforms.
segments.evidence: BSG operates through company-operated stores (generally operating under the Cosmo Prof banner), franchised stores, salon business consultants ("SBCs"), and digital platforms, including our www.cosmoprofbeauty.com website, a mobile commerce-based app, and chain portals.

revenueModel.text: Retail consumers and salon professionals pay the company for professional beauty supplies bought in stores and online.
